name: wled-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for WLED LED controllers; not affiliated with the WLED project
long_description:
Unofficial MCP server for WLED LED controllers; not affiliated with the WLED project and not endorsed by it.

This bundle contains no server code. It makes Claude Desktop start the released PyPI package `wled-mcp==REPLACE_WITH_VERSION` through `uvx`, over stdio only. The HTTP service is not part of the bundle.

Prerequisites:

- `uv` (which provides `uvx`) installed and on the PATH that Claude Desktop sees.
- A device inventory file listing your own controllers, created beforehand with `wled-mcp config init`.
- An existing, writable data directory.

The install dialog asks for the inventory file and the data directory. Nothing else is configured and no secret is stored.

The bundle is built along with each release by the project's release workflow, is not tested by the project and comes without warranty (Apache-2.0).

config_path.title: Device inventory
config_path.description: Absolute path of the device inventory (TOML file) that lists your own WLED controllers

data_dir.title: Data directory
data_dir.description: Absolute path of an existing, writable directory for the server's snapshots and stored data
